svg.title: Canelé · Meringue Cookie
svg.metadata: Built-in ImageGen prompt: Isolate the single large cookie circled in red in the reference label: an ivory, curled meringue kiss on a thin golden scalloped shortbread biscuit. Faithfully preserve its three-quarter angle, silhouette, delicate pencil lines and watercolor shading. Remove the label, red mark, paper, lettering, shadows outside the biscuit and the two loose meringues. Center the whole cookie on transparency, with a narrow, even transparent margin. This will be used as a 56 px loading icon.
